title: The plaque
logline: A bronze plaque in the grass at the face's base, found by the pup's digging: its lettering worn to nothing, the page drawing the bumps where words were. Who it was: reserved by the weather.

panels.composition: A small bronze plaque half-uncovered in the grass at the base of the carved stone face, its lettering worn smooth, a small three-legged dog's muddy paws at the edge of the hole.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small bronze plaque half uncovered in the grass at the base of a moss-grown carved stone face with its lettering worn smooth, a small three-legged dog's muddy paws at the edge of the hole, no words legible
image.notes: Worn blank: reserved by the weather.
